for x in $var (unquoted expansion in loop header) SHALL be a compile error

(( x > 0 )) as bare statement (not in if/while) SHALL be a compile error

const SHALL apply to scalars only

Sash-native: $1..$N, $@, $*, $# inside function bodies SHALL be accepted

$HOME in sash source SHALL refer to a sash variable, NOT the environment variable

export keyword SHALL be a compile error (SB5001)

$? SHALL only be available in handling position (|| RHS, if/while body)
local x=$(cmd) SHALL check cmd exit status — local SHALL NOT swallow exit codes
x=$(cmd) where cmd fails SHALL abort the program — x is never assigned
x=$(- cmd) SHALL capture output and discard exit status

- cmd1 | cmd2 SHALL suppress cmd1 failure but check cmd2
$(f) for -> int function SHALL be a type error (DD#58)

return 0 as the only return path SHALL be a compile error

$? SHALL be syntax sugar for $(status)
$! SHALL be syntax sugar for $(getcpid)
END block SHALL appear at top level, exactly once, and execute immediately before process exit
END block SHALL NOT return to the program — reaching end, return, or exit N all terminate
exit N within END SHALL override the process exit status

signal N IGN SHALL mask the signal at OS level (SIG_IGN) — zero overhead, invisible
signal N DFL SHALL restore the kernel default disposition
signal N FLAG SHALL record the signal in signum without inserting check points
signal N EXIT SHALL set the flag AND insert check points — at next check point, jump to END
Check points SHALL be inserted before external commands, function calls, function returns, and loop tops
FLAG disposition (signal N FLAG) SHALL add zero runtime overhead — no checks inserted
$(signum) SHALL return the most recent signal number as int (0 if none)
Supported signals: 1(HUP), 2(INT), 10(USR1), 12(USR2), 13(PIPE), 15(TERM)
signal takes a numeric signal argument — names are user-defined (GPP macros)
